daily QA testing during plant production Download ExcelDownload PDF **21** Checkpoints **7** Sections Daily during production; per batch/lot minimum Testing Laboratory, QC Engineer [IS 2720:1973](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2720-Part-2-1973) [SP 20:2002](https://infralens.in/code/IS-20-2002) [ASTM D6927:2021](https://infralens.in/code/IS-6927-2021) Related [📐IS 2720](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2720) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Earthwork Bulking & Shrinka…](https://infralens.in/handbook/earthwork-bulking) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧RCC design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. TEST PROCEDURE & METHODOLOGY | | A1 | Marshall specimen preparation per IS 2720 / ASTM D6927; compaction 75 blows per face
Acceptance: 75 blows per face (standard); specimen diameter 100mm ±2mm; height 63.5mm ±2mm | Cl. 503 — Sample preparation standard | | | B. STABILITY & FLOW TEST RESULTS | | B1 | Marshall Stability measured at 60°C; minimum value ≥1800 kg for normal heavy traffic
Acceptance: Minimum: 1800 kg heavy traffic; 1500 kg medium traffic; 1200 kg light traffic; measured at 60°C | Cl. 503 — Stability requirement | | | B2 | Marshall Flow measured at 60°C; target range 2-4 mm for normal mixes
Acceptance: Flow: 2-4 mm (normal); >4 mm indicates rutting potential; <2 mm indicates brittleness | Cl. 503 — Flow requirement | | | B3 | Quotient (Stability/Flow) calculated; minimum 400 kg/mm recommended
Acceptance: Quotient = Stability / Flow; value ≥400 kg/mm indicates good mix design quality | Cl. 503 — Mix quality index | | | C. VOLUMETRIC PROPERTIES | | C1 | Bulk Density measured for each specimen; average calculated
Acceptance: Measured by water immersion method (ASTM D2726) or dry specimen weighing; ±2% accuracy | Cl. 503 — Density measurement | | | C2 | Theoretical Maximum Density (TMD) determined by Rice Gravity Test (ASTM D2041)
Acceptance: Rice gravity test on same binder/aggregate blend; result ±0.05 precision | Cl. 503 — TMD determination | | | C3 | Void Ratio in Mineral Aggregate (VMA) calculated; minimum 13% for 19mm nominal size
Acceptance: VMA = (TMD - Bulk Density) × 100 / TMD; minimum: 13% (19mm), 15% (32mm) | Cl. 503 — VMA requirement | | | C4 | Void Ratio in Mix (VIM) calculated; target 3-5% for normal traffic
Acceptance: VIM = (TMD - Bulk Density) × 100 / TMD; target: 3-5%; <3% over-compact, >5% under-compact | Cl. 503 — VIM requirement | | | C5 | Voids Filled with Bitumen (VFB) calculated; target 65-75% for normal mixes
Acceptance: VFB = (VMA - VIM) × 100 / VMA; target 65-75%; <65% drains, >75% rutting risk | Cl. 503 — VFB requirement | | Showing 9 of 21 checkpoints ·View all → A.
